user-fixed-ratio.statement: 本轮固定极长比例；横版宽高比6:1、竖版宽高比1:6。

user-copy-and-no-qr.statement: 极端尺寸主标题10字以内，副标题16字以内；都不需要二维码。

user-margin-inheritance.statement: 标识、口号距离画面边距与其他模板一样；没有源文件样稿。

proposal-v1.statement: 字素计数口径、比例浮点容差、默认锚点、文本区计算、两行上限和字号缩放继承候选配置，不是PDF新增硬规范。

common-shared.note: Replaces v0.4.0 physical snapshot; extreme referenceTextWidth=1600 and 2-line candidate limits remain module overrides.

user-image-extension.statement: 按模板先计算图片区，人物优先，延展背景必须铺满图片区；测试图的手写文案允许裁切，测试确认后部署。

precedence.sourceConflict: report conflict; do not silently turn a sample or a suggestion into a brand requirement

canvas.ratioEpsilonSource: proposal-v1; floating-point comparison only, not design tolerance
canvas.unsupported: reject; do not rotate, stretch or route unsupported extreme dimensions into ordinary fallback profiles

subtitle.requiredSource: inherited optional subtitle convention; no new mandatory subtitle requirement

qr.legacyProjectUrl: can remain project metadata; never forward it as QR markup

brand.unit: D = visible height of the DiDi smile emblem; canvas height is C, not D
brand.geometryBasis: visible bounds, not transparent PNG canvas

logoHeight.override: requires an explicit approved profile; cannot auto-shrink on copy or joint-logo overflow

slogan.heightBasisStatus: Current binding uses entire visible asset including short underline; text-only height remains a review item.

brand.variantSource: special-format brand-pillar rules; exact defaults are implementation proposals
brand.portraitAlignment: same vertical center axis; swapping top and bottom is permitted
brand.landscapeAlignment: same horizontal row, or same left vertical column
brand.jointBrand: inherit common.jointBrand; group bounds determine edge margins; D remains the DiDi emblem height
brand.overflow: block; do not distort, shrink below profile or reduce prescribed gaps

placement.defaultSource: inherited ordinary ordering; special-format examples prefer top information in portrait, so the UI must show and confirm this selection
placement.swap: preserve selected S/M/L fraction; never rotate or mirror text or brand assets

definitions.T: available safe text width after selected layout and brand reservations

typography.textPosition: safe information region minus brand protection bands; top aligned; exact appearance is a proposal
typography.emptySubtitle: no subtitle box, no subtitle gap
typography.measurement: actual-font metrics required for a rendered-layout pass; estimates may only produce a preview candidate
typography.semanticLineBreak: not-enabled; requires a separate confirmed extension of regular policy

appearance.imageFit: fill actual template imageRegion using approved subject-first background extension, or user-confirmed crop with protected subject visible; see rules/image-extension.json
appearance.insufficientImage: needs-extension; use a source-hash-and-region-matched approved derived asset or obtain a new background; do not silently shrink-and-pad, mirror, blur or flat-fill
appearance.informationColor: inherit approved brand palette; unresolved color remains a review item

independent-brand-zone.canCombineWithSML: a brand identification zone is not the S/M/L information region; do not add or subtract it silently

special-lockup.scope: special aspect formats only; not ordinary templates
special-lockup.preserve: internal arrangement, separator, underline, colors and aspect; measure overall visible bounds for placement

portrait.source: PDF247 diagram; separate component, not ordinary brand pillar

special-lockup.pending: Approved complete assets, internal-spacing text/diagram consistency, and portrait 1.5D protection versus inherited 1D canvas margin.

pending: asset color variants and use scope
actual font layout and image crop checks
delivery.websiteIntegration: adapter and router must be deployed; uploading Markdown alone does not change the existing website
